title: Toward Trustworthy Evaluation of Sustainability Rating Methodologies: A Human–AI Collaborative Framework for Benchmark Dataset Construction

bias_targets.methodology: Using the SR-Delta framework to compare original ESG rating outcomes against those produced using standardized STRIDE-guided benchmark data to identify structural divergences, disclosure ambiguities, and scoring errors.

Measuring a 'Self-Served Purpose' score through mathematical modeling of transparency (explicit disclosure of assumptions) and role separation (independent oversight) to detect and mitigate conflicts of interest in evaluation.

Deploying optimization agents that dynamically switch among multiple Large Language Models (e.g., GPT-4, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Grok) during extraction and scoring to mitigate systematic biases associated with any single model architecture.
